counterfactual_missing_items: A stable normal platelet count instead of progressive decline to 21 × 10^3/μL
Normal LDH and indirect bilirubin without hemolysis
response.rationale: R3 explains the full syndrome: severe progressive thrombocytopenia, microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with schistocytes, elevated LDH and indirect hyperbilirubinemia, plus multifocal cerebral infarction as a thrombotic complication of TTP. R2 and C1 only label the ischemic strokes and omit the defining hematologic findings, so they capture a complication rather than the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Append-only anatomical completion of R2; it adds bilateral MCA localization but still omits the thrombocytopenia, schistocytes, and hemolytic profile that establish TTP as the primary cause.
